newsitem.title: USA: Mafco ups Consolidated Cigar offer.
newsitem.headline: Mafco ups Consolidated Cigar offer.

text.p: Consolidated Cigar Holdings Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for its shareholder, Mafco Consolidated Group Inc, to sell up to five million Class A common shares of Consolidated Cigar.
This is an increase from the four million shares Mafco said on January 21 it had planned to offer for sale.
Of the total amount, four million Class A common shares will be offered by Mafco in the United States and one million will be offered in the international market, the filing said.

U.S. underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 600,000 additional Class A shares while international underwriters have been granted 150,000 additional shares, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.
Mafco is 85 percent owned by Ronald Perelman through Mafco Holdings Inc.

Consolidated Cigar, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., is the largest manufacturer and marketer of cigars sold in the United States in terms of dollar sales, with a 1995 market share of about 23 percent, according to company estimates.
